verdicts.reason: Both use the same stacked layout at the same size, and in each the whole text block sits about 17px off the canvas centre (A to the left, B to the right). In both, the headline is undersized for the banner, the tagline is jammed under the subcopy with almost no gap, and the block leaves wide empty yellow on either side instead of a left-to-right banner layout.

In A, the subcopy and the PACEWELL tagline are shrunk to unreadable micro-text, and the subcopy wraps so that 'next.' is orphaned on its own line. That breaks readability and hierarchy. B keeps the subcopy readable on one line and is centred, but the line spacing is cramped (tagline right under the subcopy), the headline is small for the canvas, and it is still just a centred stack rather than a layout made for a banner.
